subject.title: [优化建议] 添加结构化错误处理和智能重试机制

question: Which npm installer failures should OpenClaw auto-retry or auto-repair, and where should it only print remediation guidance?
rationale: The source shows a real diagnostics gap, but cross-platform npm prefix repair, transient-network retries, and optional setup probe strictness can change install behavior and need maintainer intent before a safe repair PR.

options.title: Define narrow retry and repair policy
options.body: Classify known npm failures, retry only transient idempotent network failures, and add platform-specific EACCES guidance or repair with focused Bash and PowerShell tests.

options.title: Guidance-only diagnostics
options.body: Keep install behavior mostly unchanged but improve EACCES, ENOSPC, EBADENGINE, and network-error messages with clear next commands and docs links.

options.title: Keep current partial behavior
options.body: Accept the current npm code/syscall/errno output, Linux prefix repair, and targeted cleanup retries without adding a broader installer error policy.

recommendation.title: Define narrow retry and repair policy
recommendation.body: Classify known npm failures, retry only transient idempotent network failures, and add platform-specific EACCES guidance or repair with focused Bash and PowerShell tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest current-main history across the Bash installer, PowerShell installer, and Docker setup surfaces implicated by the policy decision.
